blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified at Polygon block 94755001 on 2026-10-01: the proxy now points to CollateralToken 0xce84e053301a82937f90ee2c2c1889cab1db25de and owner() remains Timelock 0x47ebfac3353314c788b96cdcbf41daadfe03629c. Current verified source defines collateral wrapping/unwrapping, minter-role burn of msg.sender balances, owner rescue of assets held by the token contract, role administration, and UUPS authorization. It and its inherited ERC20 source contain no direct holder blacklist, freeze, seizure, or arbitrary-holder burn mechanism. Collateral ramps can pause their wrap/unwrap paths; that does not freeze existing pUSD transfers. Circle's USDC blocklisting and owner-controlled future upgrades remain adverse upstream/control exposure. The inherited review is retained.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PUSD has one reviewed native issuance deployment on Polygon. Polymarket's official Bridge API is a material multi-source cross-chain deposit and withdrawal route: source assets are sent to API-created deposit addresses, delivered to Polygon, and wrapped into PUSD, while withdrawals unwrap PUSD to USDC before bridging or swapping to external assets. The underlying bridge or swap provider, custody and escrow addresses, validators or DVNs, peers, rate limits, pause and upgrade administrators, and conservation or reconciliation evidence are not disclosed. No additional PUSD representation or bridge controller is inferred, so the route profile remains opaque-or-unknown.
